description: This file contains a static utility class `RuntimeTypeNameFormatter` which provides methods for formatting .NET `Type` instances into strings that can be parsed back into the same type using `Type.GetType()`. It includes features for caching, handling arrays, pointers, generics, nested types, and custom type aliases, primarily aimed at serializing type information for deserialization purposes.

classes.name: RuntimeTypeNameFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to generate parseable string representations of .NET types for serialization and deserialization processes.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Public method to get a string representation of a `Type` that can be parsed back using `Type.GetType()`. Uses caching to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: FormatInternalNoCache
methods.description: Internal method to format a `Type` into its string representation without using cache, allowing for custom options regarding aliases.
